author: Frenchi' J.
title: Not Challenging
content:
The game doesn’t give me that feeling of wanting to continue to play it. 

I didn’t find any challenge or logic to this game until the timer began to shorten on time.
This happens around level 40.

So instead of finding a challenge within the actual game, you realize it’s you VS the timer. 

Also, 2 of the boosters basically do the same action. 

One allows you to destroy every color of the same block you want out of the way, whilst the other allows you to destroy 1-2 blocks you want out of the way. 

I enjoy color matching style games, but I’ve only lost 1 level & I’m almost to level 100. & The only reason I lost the 1 level was due to me not realizing I was short on time. 

They don’t give a tutorial on the boosters, so I didn’t realize there was one that froze your time. If I’d known which booster did what, I wouldn’t have lost that 1 level.

Lastly, i currently have about 3hrs in unlimited playtime. Instead of constantly giving 15♾️, 30 ♾️, or 1hr ♾️, they should give more boosters & coins.

I keep playing because I’m trying to see if the game will eventually challenge me. However, after the forced push to leave a review , I figured I’d give a heads up to others considering downloading.

author: Guesstimate
title: Daily Reward Is Rigged — Always Coins
content:
I tested the daily reward for an entire month, selecting the same center slot every single day. Every time, I received coins. I then started choosing different slots and continued receiving only coins, but suddenly the center slot began revealing better prizes whenever I didn’t select it.

This strongly suggests that the prizes aren’t actually assigned to specific slots and that the game creates the illusion that you narrowly missed a better reward. It’s misleading and makes the daily reward feel completely rigged. If the reward is predetermined, don’t pretend players have a meaningful choice.
